media.caption: (Rey Lopez for The Washington Post; food styling by Lisa Cherkasky for The Washington Post)

excerpt.text: Do you serve soup at Thanksgiving? If not, you’re missing out. I can’t think of a more comforting, warm (literally) way to welcome your guests and kick off a special meal. For me, soup on Thanksgiving is nonnegotiable. Besides a cozy way to start our dinner, soup is an ideal cook-in-advance dish — it will fit right in with the make-ahead Thanksgiving recipes we’re sharing this year — and it can be easily reheated.
